meta.description: Compare Virgin Voyages, Royal Caribbean, Celebrity, Silversea and Atlantis. Explore your options and plan with Dean On Deck.
meta.ogTitle: One advisor. Every ocean. — Cruises with Dean on Deck
meta.ogDescription: Compare the cruise lines Dean books and find your next voyage with personal support at no cost to you.

hero.heading: One advisor. *Every ocean.*
hero.lede: From adults-only escapes to family adventures, luxury voyages and LGBTQ+ charters, let’s find your fit. Use my Virgin Voyages link to book independently, or contact me first about booking with my support on another line.

cta.heading: Not sure where to start? *Let’s talk.*
cta.lede: Tell me who’s sailing and what you’d love to experience. We’ll explore your options together, with my planning help at no cost to you.

rockstar.heading: Cruise like a RockStar
rockstar.intro: Three ways to sail: Mega RockStar, RockStar and Non-RockStar. Find the experience that fits your voyage.
rockstar.regular: Inside, Sea View or Sea Terrace — with all the voyage inclusions above.
coreItems: All shared voyage inclusions, plus suite accommodation
Richard’s Rooftop, RockStar Agent team and priority access
Curated in-suite bar — first round included
Classic Wi-Fi — one device per sailor
megaItems: All shared inclusions and RockStar privileges
Dedicated Mega RockStar Agent and replenished in-suite bar
Daily shipwide Bar Tab, with drink and bottle limits
Daily Thermal Suite access; transfers or parking where available
Work from Sea Wi-Fi — two devices per sailor
rockstar.note: RockStar shipwide alcoholic drinks are extra. Premium drinks, dining extras and some ticketed experiences cost extra. Benefits and connectivity depend on your fare, sailing and availability.
includedItems: Soft drinks, still & sparkling water, tea and drip coffee
Wi-Fi, entertainment and group fitness classes
nonItems: Dining, essential beverages, entertainment and fitness included
Wi-Fi included; level depends on your fare

royal.heading: Find your kind of Royal
royal.intro: From a private retreat to a Royal Genie experience, choose the space and service that suit your crew.
included: Dining in complimentary restaurants and casual venues
Water, tea, classic coffee and select juices
Shows, pools, fitness facilities and many onboard activities

tiers.title: Star Class
items: Royal Genie service for a personalized voyage
Most specialty dining included; selected experiences carry a charge
Deluxe Beverage Package for eligible adults; refreshment package for younger guests
VOOM internet: one device per guest
Standard service gratuities included; Genie tips are separate

tiers.title: Sky Class
items: Concierge service and priority dining reservations
Coastal Kitchen access; dinner reservations required
Suite Lounge and suite sun deck access
VOOM internet in eligible suites; category exceptions apply
Flexible arrival boarding and priority departure

tiers.title: Sea Class
items: Suite comfort with upgraded bedding, bath amenities and espresso machine
Dedicated check-in line and priority boarding
Coastal Kitchen dinner, subject to availability and reservation
Internet, beverage packages and gratuities are additional

royal.stateroomText: Your own place to recharge, with all the shared cruise inclusions above. Choose an interior retreat, a window to the ocean or your own balcony. Internet and beverage packages can be added.
royal.note: Royal Suite Class is offered on participating Oasis, Quantum and Icon class ships; benefits and venues vary by ship and suite. Sky Junior Suites and Sunset Junior Suites exclude VOOM. Sky Balcony (BY) on Spectrum includes VOOM only for bookings made on or before April 27, 2026. Specialty dining, drinks outside included packages, excursions and some activities cost extra. Dean will confirm your exact inclusions before booking.

silversea.heading: Your suite. Your sanctuary.
silversea.intro: An all-suite voyage with personal butler service at every level. Choose the space, setting and attention that feel right for you.
included: Onboard gratuities, port taxes and fees

tiers.title: Villa
items: The collection’s most expansive suites, with generous living spaces and terraces
Includes Otium, Master, Owner’s, Grand and Royal suites
From January 2027: enhanced arrival and personalized signature experiences

tiers.title: Residence
items: Separate bedroom and living spaces for more room to settle in
Includes Junior Grand, Signature, Silver and Medallion suite types
From January 2027: earlier dining and spa reservations; priority embarkation on Classic voyages

tiers.title: Veranda
items: Your own private balcony for open-air views
Classic, Superior, Deluxe and Premium Veranda options, depending on ship
All shared Silversea inclusions, with standard Wi-Fi

tiers.title: Oceanview
items: Expansive sea views through a picture window
Vista and Panorama suites, depending on ship
All shared Silversea inclusions and personal butler service

silversea.note: Suite types and benefits vary by ship and sailing. Enhanced Residence and Villa benefits apply to departures on or after January 1, 2027; some benefits differ between Classic and Expedition voyages. Air, transfers, shore experiences and premium extras depend on the fare and itinerary. Dean will confirm what is included before you book.
